title: VideoTypeDefaults
description: Which style pack each video type starts from. A pack's own `video_type` is advisory and several packs may declare the same one, so the answer to 'what does doc mean' cannot live on the packs — it is a MAPPING, and a mapping belongs in one document where a type cannot have two answers. Read by the simplified Channel screen and the quote statement when the video type changes; the advanced channel form still points a channel at any pack it likes.

defaults.description: video type -> style pack name. A type with no entry falls back to the first pack declaring that type, in name order.
